title: Data Basics
subtitle: 4 cards | 2 pairs
objective: Find 2 matching pairs of programming concepts before the flip attempts run out.

question.prompt: What is a variable in programming?

options.label: A named storage location that holds a value
A function that returns a fixed number
A type of computer hardware
A loop that runs forever

hints: Think of it as a labeled box for data.
Its value can be read and updated by name.
question.explanation: A variable is a named storage location that holds a value. The value can be read, reassigned, and referenced anywhere in scope.

question.prompt: What values can a boolean hold?

options.label: true or false only
Any whole number
Any text string
null only

hints: It has exactly two possible states.

question.explanation: A boolean is a primitive type that holds one of two values: true or false. It is the foundation of all conditional and logical operations.
